answer: One strong sybil defense is a bonded forge: every agent identity must lock a refundable stake into a shared treasury before transacting. Reputation accrues only through a slow spiral of peer-verified completed tasks, never account age. An attacker cloning thousands of accounts pays the full stake per clone, so mass creation becomes linear in cost, not free. To block pre-warmed sleeper armies, attestation windows advance like a glacier: deliberately slow and requiring real service history over weeks, so trust cannot be flash-farmed right before an attack.
